definitions.explanation: A liquid fossil fuel used for energy and making products.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
{石油|せきゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}している→輸入する：01742_yunyuu⟧。
{石油|せきゆ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{石油|せきゆ} means petroleum or crude oil, a major energy source.

KANJI:
{石|せき} (stone) + {油|ゆ} (oil) - "stone oil" (oil from the ground).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {石油|せきゆ}{会社|がいしゃ}: oil company
- {石油|せきゆ}{価格|かかく}: oil prices
- {石油|せきゆ}{製品|せいひん}: petroleum products
- {石油|せきゆ}{産出|さんしゅつ}{国|こく}: oil-producing country

RELATED TERMS:
- {灯油|とうゆ}: kerosene (for heating)
- ガソリン: gasoline
- {原油|げんゆ}: crude oil

CONTEXT:
Japan imports nearly all its {石油|せきゆ}, primarily from the Middle East. {石油|せきゆ}ショック (oil shock) refers to the 1970s oil crises.
